explication: Shoutrrr is a self-hosted social publishing and account-management application. Users connect social accounts, compose a post, select destinations, then publish immediately or schedule it; per-target publishing supports retries and platform-specific behavior. The product also includes analytics, engagement and messaging inboxes, native-post syncing, team workspaces, and API/MCP access. The README documents the principal capabilities; source excerpts and the SOURCE INDEX provide implementation links for selected controllers, services, jobs, and models, but do not expose every runtime connection.
